must_fix.title: Home page script (js/home.js) has no tests
must_fix.evidence: books.js, events.js and contact.js each have a test file (tests/books.test.cjs, events.test.cjs, contact.test.cjs), but home.js has none. `grep -n "picks\|home-events" tests/*.cjs` returns no matches. The staff picks, the 3-event cap, the today-based upcoming filter and the #home-events-empty message are all untested; only the site-wide nav/heading/console checks load index.html. A manual run with a fixed clock shows it currently works (16 Nov 2026: 3 picks and 3 events; 2 Jan 2027: empty message visible), so this is missing coverage, not a bug.

nits: An event that started earlier today is still listed as upcoming until midnight; this is deliberate and tested, but debatable.
Arrowing through the genre select in Chrome fires a change on every key press, and each one adds a history entry.
The tests hard-code /usr/bin/google-chrome and need a globally installed Playwright, which is not portable.
README phrase 'a list of events split into upcoming ones' is garbled.
The opening-hours table has no <caption> or aria-labelledby.

report:
I'd hold this PR for one fix. It meets the issue, all 33 tests pass, and I found no behavior bugs, but the home page script, `js/home.js`, has no tests at all.

**What I checked:**
- **Tests:** `NODE_PATH=$(npm root -g) node --test 'tests/*.test.cjs'` gives `# tests 33 … # pass 33 # fail 0`. The repo has no lint, format or type-check setup to run.
- **Issue requirements:** all met.
  - Four pages share the same nav, with the current page marked.
  - The catalogue has 15 books in 5 genres, and the filter works.
  - Events and visit pages are complete: the visit page has hours, address and a contact form.
  - `index.html` is at the root, there's no build step, and no page asks for anything from another site.
  - No page scrolls sideways at 360px.
- **Opening the files directly (`file://`):** I filtered the catalogue to poetry and back to all. The URL followed each change, the Back button restored the poetry filter, and there were no errors.
- **Colour contrast:** every text and background pair passes (muted text on paper is 6.91:1, accent on paper 8.27:1, gold on ink 10.77:1, white on accent 9.3:1). Focus outlines are visible.
- **Home page by hand:** with the clock set to 16 Nov 2026 it shows 3 staff picks and the next 3 events. Set to 2 Jan 2027, the "No upcoming events" message shows. So it works, but no test covers it.

**Must fix: tests for the home page script.**
- `books.js`, `events.js` and `contact.js` each have their own test file. `home.js` has none.
- `grep -n "picks\|home-events" tests/*.cjs` finds nothing. Its only coverage is the site-wide checks for nav, headings and console errors.
- Untested: the staff picks (first book of each of the first three genres), the "Coming up" cap of 3 events, which events count as upcoming, and the empty message (`#home-events-empty`).
- A `tests/home.test.cjs` using the same fixed-clock approach as `events.test.cjs` would cover these.

**Nits:**
- An event that started earlier today still shows as upcoming until midnight. This is deliberate and tested, but at 22:00 on 3 Dec the 19:00 book club still appears.
- In Chrome, arrowing through the genre dropdown fires a change on every key press. Each one adds a history entry, so Back has to step through every genre passed on the way.
- The tests hard-code `/usr/bin/google-chrome` and a globally installed Playwright, so they won't run on most other machines as written.
- The README has a garbled phrase: "a list of events split into upcoming ones".
- The hours table could use a `<caption>`, or `aria-labelledby` pointing at its heading.

`git status` is unchanged. My probe scripts are in `/tmp/claude-0/-tmp-ff-eval-wt47enm5-workspace/ce12d720-af05-4a91-9f93-96178b78aa61/scratchpad/p`.
